text: Coffee with Aneesh. He's finally joined a five a side league, Tuesday nights, and his knee is holding up. His sister Tanvi is running the Bristol half early March and is properly nervous about it. Text her the day before.
Isabel and Juan are doing a housewarming end of the month, haven't set the date yet. They want everyone to bring a plant instead of booze. Isabel's really into pottery now, does a class on Thursdays.
Blessing's choir has a concert sometime next week. She's got a solo and admitted she's been feeling sick about it. Must message her good luck that morning.
Caught up with Manon on the phone. Her dad turns 70 over the summer and she's planning a garden party for him. She asked if I'd help with the playlist. He loves old Motown apparently.

Duc's band got the support slot at the Exchange! Gig is the 14th, soundcheck that afternoon. Already said I'll go. Ask him afterwards how the new songs went down. His drummer Eli just had a baby so they nearly pulled out, but Eli's mum is covering the night. Duc said the after party is at his place, the night of the gig, and I'm welcome.
Demi's dinner party cancelled, her flat flooded. She's staying with her mum for a bit. Check in with her sometime next week.

Bogdan has gone deep into chess again, plays online every night and is entering a rapid tournament in early November. His wife Irina thinks he's lost the plot. He wants a proper wooden set, could be a good Christmas present. Irina is doing a ceramics course on Saturdays to get him out from under her feet, and she said their dog Pushkin sits on the board whenever Bogdan leaves it out. They're having people over for blinis sometime over the holidays.
Chioma's 30th is Saturday, drinks at the Crown then food afterwards. Need to sort a card before then.

Long chat with Aisha after yoga. She's moved to Leith, loves it. Her brother Hamza is getting married in the spring and she's on hen-do-equivalent duty for his side, whatever that's called. She's a bit overwhelmed with it all. Also she's started climbing with her flatmate Noor, they go to the wall on Leith Walk twice a week. Aisha wants me to come along sometime next month. Her mum's visiting from Kano early December and she's nervous about hosting.
Luis ran his first marathon on Sunday. Crossed in 4:12. Send him something to say well done, he was so chuffed.
Patrick and Hadiza invited us to their anniversary dinner, 10 years! It's the Friday after next. Hadiza said Patrick's been collecting vinyl, mostly jazz, so maybe a record as a gift.
Kofi is doing the Great North Run end of September. Raising money for the hospice that looked after his gran. Donate before the day.
Need to book the car in for MOT sometime next week.
Jakub's daughter has her first piano recital on the 22nd. He's more nervous than she is, ha. He'll send me a video afterwards.
Ming told me she's knitting a whole blanket for her nephew who's due in December. Her sister's expecting her second. She also mentioned she's into bouldering now, goes three times a week.
Sadia's play opens Thursday, she's playing Lady Macbeth. Cast party the night after. Remember to ask her how opening night went.
Rafael's team won the pub quiz league! Final was last night. Farah said he's insufferable about it now. Both of them coming to mine for dinner early next month.
Irina mentioned Bogdan's birthday is the week after the tournament. She wants to get him a chess clock. Maybe chip in.
Tanvi's half marathon went well apparently, 1:58. Need to text her congrats, totally forgot.
Noor has a new rescue dog called Biscuit, a greyhound. Biscuit has her vet check next Monday. Noor's also started doing parkrun with her.
Xavier's leaving do is at the end of the month. He's off to Lisbon for a new job. I'm doing the collection for the card.
Talked to Anya about her pottery. She's selling at the Christmas market in early December and is stressing about having enough stock. Offer to help her price things the weekend before.
Kalani Nakamura from work plays roller derby, her derby name is Kali Krush. Bout on Saturday, she's invited a few of us. Seems really good at it.
Petra's book club picked my suggestion. Next meeting sometime mid November at hers. Must finish the book before then.

Ricardo and Eli are hosting Thanksgiving this year even though neither is American. Eli's doing the turkey, Ricardo's terrified of it going wrong. Late November, date tbc. They've invited about twelve people including Petra and her new boyfriend. Eli asked me to bring a pie, pecan ideally, and to come early that afternoon to help set up. Ricardo's also roped in his sister Petra to do the cocktails.
Dmitri's band broke up so the gig on the 3rd is off. He's gutted but says he'll start something new over the winter.

Dinner with Aneesh and his partner Isabel last night. They're both obsessed with Formula 1, flying to Abu Dhabi for the final race. Isabel's mum is staying to look after the cat while they're away. Ask how it was when they're back. Aneesh also said he's finally finished his Lego Millennium Falcon after two years, and he's after the Death Star next, which would be a great birthday present if anyone's chipping in. His birthday's early February.
Blessing said her mum's having a knee op early January. Blessing's taking a week off afterwards to help out. She seemed worried.
Juan plays in a Sunday league, centre back. Has a cup semi in two weeks. Text him the night before.
Manon is doing a pottery course, every Wednesday till Easter.
Duc mentioned his girlfriend Demi's birthday is end of the month and he has no idea what to get. She's been eyeing a film camera.
Bogdan's tournament: came 3rd! He was buzzing. His son Jakub is now wanting to learn too.
Chioma Lopez asked if I'd come to her exhibition opening on the 9th. Paintings, mostly portraits. Wine reception that evening and a talk the next day. I said yes to the opening.
Aisha's brother Hamza got engaged last week! Engagement party is sometime in January. Aisha's helping plan it but she's swamped at work. Should send Hamza a card before then.
Must remember to call Luis after his race on Saturday to see how it went. Second marathon, he wants under four hours.
Hadiza is training for a triathlon in early June. Swims before work, cycles at weekends. Says the open water bit scares her.
Kofi's housewarming is the 18th. He's in Peckham now. Bring something vegan, his flatmate Ricardo is vegan.
Text Jakub on Friday, his recital is the day after.
Ming and her husband are throwing a Diwali party, the Saturday before. Ming said bring the kids. She's cooking for forty, bless her.

Bumped into Sadia in town. She's got an audition for a touring production sometime next week and is a nervous wreck. Wish her luck the day before. Her girlfriend Noor is driving her down to London for it. If she gets it, rehearsals start after New Year and the tour runs over the summer. Noor's not thrilled about six months apart but is being supportive. Sadia's also been learning ukulele to calm her nerves, which is very her.
Rafael is really into Warhammer, paints miniatures most evenings. Has a tournament at the end of the month in Nottingham. Farah says the spare room is now a model shop.

Big catch-up with Farah over lunch. She's been promoted to head of design, starts the new role after Christmas. Her and Rafael are finally doing their wedding party in the summer, just a big barbecue. She's also started learning the cello, which I did not see coming. Asked me to keep a weekend in July free. Need to send congrats on the promotion properly.
Irina said her mum passed away last month. Funeral was in Kyiv, she flew out for a week. She's back now and seems ok but tired. Check in with her next week.
Got invited to Tanvi's 40th, a ceilidh in a village hall, mid February. Fancy dress optional. Tanvi loves gin, so maybe a nice bottle.
Noor's half marathon is the 12th. Then the next day she's flying to Morocco for a week. Ask her afterwards how both went.
Mrs Wright next door asked if I'd feed the cat while she's at her granddaughter's christening next weekend. Said yes.

Xavier and Anya came round. Xavier's leaving do got moved to the Friday after next, he's flying out the day after. Anya is running the Lisbon marathon next spring, so she'll visit him then. Xavier's mum is coming over from France for the drinks. Anya says she's doing a speech and wants me to look over it the day before. Xavier mentioned he's selling his bike and his guitar before he goes, and asked if I'd want the guitar.
Kalani's derby team won their bout. She's now trying out for the national squad in early March. Remind me to message her before trials.
Petra's son Eli has his grade 5 piano exam sometime next week. She says he hasn't practised at all. Ask how it went.
Ricardo hates surprise parties, Eli warned me, so the plan for his 50th is just a dinner. End of the month, somewhere Portuguese. I'm booking the table.
Dmitri plays the cello in an amateur orchestra. Concert is in early December, Elgar. He's invited me. Says the rehearsals the week before are brutal.

Rang Aneesh. His dad's been in hospital with his heart, home now. Aneesh is doing his best to keep things normal but sounds exhausted. Visit at the weekend. His wife Manon is holding it all together, still doing her park runs every Saturday morning to stay sane. Their son's school play is the week after next and Aneesh is determined to be there. Maybe take them a lasagne so nobody has to cook.
Sunday plan: big shop, then football, then prep for the week.
Patrick's choir is singing at the cathedral Christmas Eve. He's been practising the descant for weeks. Bring Hadiza a mince pie for the interval, she always forgets food.
Isabel's knitting circle are doing a charity knit-a-thon at the end of the month. She asked if I could donate some wool. Drop it round sometime next week.

Juan Santos and his wife Blessing are expecting twins, due early spring! They told everyone at Juan's birthday drinks on Friday. Blessing has awful morning sickness. Juan's mum is moving in for a bit afterwards to help. Must get them something small to congratulate.
Demi got into the roller derby team, the same one as Kalani! First proper bout is in early April. She's really chuffed.
Watched Hamza's five a side final. They lost on penalties. He's fine about it. Pub afterwards.
Hadiza's book club is reading Middlemarch which she's finding a slog. She mostly goes for the cake. Next one's at the end of the month.

Dr Le, Ming's mum, retires at the end of the year after thirty years as a GP. Ming's organising a surprise do for her the week after. I've been asked to bring dessert. Don't forget to RSVP by Friday. Ming says her mum's into birdwatching and has been eyeing up new binoculars, so a few of us might chip in. Ming's brother Duc is flying back from Hanoi for it, landing the morning of the party.
